# Trump Announces Plans to Soon Visit Egypt

by Naharnet Newsdesk almost 8 years

 W300 U.S. President Donald Trump told Egyptian President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi on Sunday during talks in the Saudi capital that he would soon visit Egypt. "We will absolutely be putting that on the list very soon," Trump said at the beginning of bilateral talks with Sisi, hours before the U.S. president is scheduled to address an Arab Islamic American summit. Trump praised U.S. relations with Egypt, describing the talks with Sisi as "very very important." "We've really been through a lot together positively," he said. Trump said that "safety seems to be very strong" in Egypt, which has seen deadly bombings and attacks on Christian Copts and security forces in past months. Responding through an interpreter, Sisi said: "Egypt is secure and stable and is going very well with the cooperation ... "You are a unique personality that is capable of doing the impossible," Sisi said, addressing Trump. "I agree!," the billionaire president responded as everyone laughed.
